hooks.text: 追逐照亮天空的金色流星，沿主线揭开金色传说，并用百余支线补全新世界
hooks.excerpt: ◆Chase the golden meteors and uncover the secrets of the golden legend, with abundant mainline chapters waiting for you to play! ◆ Explore a brand new world, experience different customs, and learn more about this world through more than a hundred side quests!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 数千件独特装备叠加随机暗金词条、远古与泰坦升阶，还能收集符文打造精英武器
hooks.excerpt: ◆Thousands of well-designed unique equipment, hundreds of dark entries and randomly dropped enhanced spoils. ◆Surprises in dropping equipment, chances to upgrade to ancient equipment , even the legendary Titan creation !!!! ◆Rune words, collect the lost runes in all parts of the world to build the elite weapon!!!!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 五十多名角色各有独立技能树，再用十套天赋自由换算伤害或交换魔攻物攻
hooks.excerpt: ◆ 50+ characters can be freely made to your own favorite team. Each character has an independent skill tree, for example, you can let Aikun (character) use Chicken Claw , HardStrike for ADC , you can also let him use the of serial earth of Basketball or Egg-laying to attack the enemies! ◆Ten talent trees with a large number of skills, free DIY. You can strengthen the basic attributes through the talent, the lightning damage into physical damage. If you don't want to be a mage and want to play as a tank, you can even swap the magic attack with your physical attack
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
